ADHD-200 CC200 Cortical Atlas

Source: R/data.R
adhd200_200_cortical.Rd

Cortical parcellation from the Craddock CC200 spatially constrained spectral clustering of 650 ADHD-200 subjects.

Usage

adhd200_200_cortical()

Value

A ggseg.formats::ggseg_atlas object (cortical).

References

Craddock RC, et al. (2012). Human Brain Mapping, 33(8):1914-1928. doi:10.1002/hbm.21333

See also

Other ggseg_atlases: adhd200_200_subcortical(), adhd200_400_cortical(), adhd200_400_subcortical(), craddock200_cortical(), craddock200_subcortical()

Other cortical_atlases: adhd200_400_cortical(), craddock200_cortical()

Examples

adhd200_200_cortical()
#> 
#> ── adhd200_200_cortical ggseg atlas ────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Type: cortical
#> Regions: 150
#> Hemispheres: left, right
#> Views: inferior, lateral, medial, superior
#> Palette: ✔
#> Rendering: ✔ ggseg
#> ✔ ggseg3d (vertices)
